title: Chapter 65
text:
Han Xiao wrote down the list of materials and sent it to Feng Jun.

"Oh my God, you want BOK composite colloid, Farr IV solvent, and 12 sets of microelectronic components. Do you know the price of these things?"

"I have money."

Feng Jun was speechless. He just remembered that Han Xiao was different from a civil servant like him. He had made a lot of money from the mechanical orders. He was a typical rich man.

An hour later, Feng Jun delivered three suitcases to Han Xiao's office.

The suitcases had black linings. In the first case, there were three transparent tubes that were 10 centimeters long. They were filled with a milky white viscous solution. This was BOK composite colloid. In the second case, there was a small bottle that contained a light blue solution, Farr IV solvent.

These two materials were new materials that could only be synthesized in a laboratory. They were very precious. Just a few small bottles cost 120,000 yuan.

In the third case, there were 12 sets of microelectronic components. Each of them was only the size of two or three fingernails. They were very thin and had electronic patterns all over them. They were usually used in precision instruments. The total cost was 60,000 RMB.

After getting the materials, Han Xiao started to build them behind closed doors.

First, he used a plastic plate to carve out a human face mold. He opened the eyes, nose, and mouth holes. Then, he used a steel needle to pierce 12 points in the mold, distributed in different positions.

Han Xiao turned on the computer and used a special reading device to connect the microelectronic components. He reset and synchronized all the microelectronic components to share the same program. He used the scanner to record his facial features. Then, he collected thousands of facial features and recorded them into the database. After collecting the differences between the facial features, he started to program. This work lasted for two to three hours. A simple simulation program was created.

He took out the BOK colloid and Farr IV solvent. He took out the unopened chemical instruments, test tubes, conduits, and various instruments from the warehouse. After a while, through the complicated chemical process, he mixed the two immiscible materials. Then, through the process mainly for the ionization reaction, a new composite material was formed. It was not milky white or light blue, but flesh-colored.

This new material combined the characteristics of BOK colloid and Farr IV solvent, as well as good electrical conductivity. This was the basic material for the artificial optical mask, using the knowledge of [Basic Biochemistry].

Han Xiao carefully placed the micro-electronic components on the twelve marks of the mold, gently poured the new material solution, and sealed the mold after a few procedures, waiting for the solidification reaction.

Counting the time, Han Xiao immediately opened the mold. A thin mask as thin as a cicada's wing was lying quietly in the mold. At this step, the manufacturing process was almost over. Han Xiao finished the last few steps and was soon done.

He reached out and pressed on it. The position of the electronic components felt slightly hard, but overall, it felt very smooth. The surface of the mask was covered with a liquid crystal coating. When the finger pressed on it, a colorful halo would appear around the pressure point, just like the changes on a liquid crystal screen.

You have created [Artificial Intelligence Optical Mask]. You have gained 5,000 EXP!

The cost of this mask was close to 200,000 EXP.

Han Xiao picked up the mask and put it on his face. It felt cool and refreshing to the touch. He walked in front of the mirror, reached out his finger, and pressed on the electronic device on his cheek. The facial features in the mirror suddenly changed into the face of an unfamiliar man. Han Xiao pressed a few more times, and the facial features changed again. They were all completely different faces.

This was not an ordinary human skin mask, but a mask that could change one's appearance at any time. It was a stealth artifact!

The electronic components were entered into the facial simulation program, located at the key parts that determined the facial features of the face. Through the built-in database, the mask was like a screen, fitting the facial features, and the facial features were completely three-dimensional. The mask was very realistic. As long as the switch was pressed, the facial features could be randomly simulated.

The Artificial Intelligence Optical Mask had a total of four functions. The first was simulation, which randomly changed the facial features. According to the program set by Han Xiao, the facial features would not jump out of the human category, and there was no need to worry about the appearance of an ancient god.

The second function was memory, which could record three different facial features and could be replaced.

The third function was reset, which could restore three different facial features at any time. There was no need to worry about losing the original disguise after the simulation.

The fourth function was scan simulation, which could be hidden in the mask to quickly scan the face of a humanoid target and change it into the target's appearance. The similarity could reach 70-80%. It was a godly skill.

Han Xiao played with it for a while, then took off the Artificial Intelligence Optical Mask and went to the headquarters to visit Gu Hui.

"You created the Artificial Appearance Mask?" Gu Hui asked.

Han Xiao laughed and put on the mask.

He had already memorized the face of the first person before he came. It was an ordinary looking young man, and he did not reveal the mask's ability to change facial features in front of Gu Hui.

This function was Han Xiao's trump card.

Gu Hui looked at it and thought that Han Xiao was only wearing a human skin mask. Division 13 also knew how to make one, but it was not as realistic as Han Xiao's. Moreover, this mask was very light and seemed to be easier to carry around.

"Are you interested in submitting the blueprint to the bureau?"

Han Xiao laughed and said, "It's just a human skin mask. There's no need for a blueprint. Don't you guys know how to make your own?"

Gu Hui agreed and did not insist. Han Xiao saw this and secretly heaved a sigh of relief.

He had fooled them!

Han Xiao quickly changed the topic. "Can I participate in the operation personally?"

Gu Hui thought for a while and nodded. "The higher-ups have communicated with Hesla. Hesla's military intelligence department has decided to cooperate with us. This time, you will follow your team."

The Dark Crow Valley base was located at the border of Hesla. Han Xiao guessed that Hesla would not reject him.

After confirming that he would participate in the operation, Han Xiao suppressed his excitement and asked, "When will we depart?"

"There's no rush. It takes time to mobilize the troops. Moreover, the General Staff Department has to come up with a specific strategy with Hesla. It will take at least half a month before we can depart."

Half a month was enough for him to complete all the modifications.

…

After returning to the studio, Han Xiao wrote down the main points of his work for the next half a month on a piece of paper.

First, increase the number of blueprints for his trump cards.

Second, purchase a vehicle for his team. As a logistics officer, he needed to provide equipment maintenance and supplies for his team. Therefore, he needed a logistics vehicle.

Third, upgrade Zhang Wei's Battler armor.

"This is a big project. Let's do it one by one."

Han Xiao shook his head.

First, he needed stronger combat power. He could consider the following aspects.

First, defense. This was the aspect that he valued the most. Being able to survive was the most important thing.

Long-range attack. This required more powerful firearms. Two Berserk Eagles were barely enough. He only needed to upgrade them once.

Close combat weapons. Although Han Xiao preferred long-range weapons, he still needed to prevent others from getting close to him. Lightweight Mechanical Arm needed to be modified.

Mobility in harsh terrain. Cloud Swallow Glider had been gathering dust on the interface for a long time. Finally, it was time to put it to use.

Lastly, attack power. He had to consider situations where he was surrounded or needed to be a troublemaker in a group battle. Therefore, he needed to use powerful means to break through the situation. Art was a good choice.

Explosions were art.

Han Xiao quickly came up with an idea. He quickly wrote down a list of materials and asked Feng Jun to go to the warehouse to collect them. This batch of materials was worth 300,000 yuan. It was very expensive.

Feng Jun was getting more and more helpless with Han Xiao. He felt that he was going to become a babysitter. The orders from the higher-ups were to protect Han Xiao in all aspects. Han Xiao was very difficult to deal with. The higher-ups seemed to be very clear about this and gave him a better treatment as a form of consolation. What else could Feng Jun say? For a monthly salary of 25,000 yuan and five insurances and housing funds, he could only do it.

"Maybe this is what they mean by the greater the power, the greater the responsibility."
